_readme: EXPLICIT TIER BANLISTS for Sid's PC pool (~360 OU-legal fusions).
Because the pool is a closed, enumerable set, tiers are defined by explicit banlists
rather than rules, so every call can be a judgment call.
IDENTITY: matching uses the ENGINE'S OWN canonical fusion id - the species symbol
That symbol is stored on every Pokemon and produced by getFusedPokemonIdFromDexNum,
so it is immutable and exactly unique per fusion.
Write entries either way - 'MAROWAK/MIMIKYU' (resolved to the canonical id at load) or
'B373H105' (the id directly). Order matters: MAROWAK/CROBAT != CROBAT/MAROWAK.
Nicknames are deliberately NOT accepted - they are auto-generated, change whenever a
fusion is rebuilt, are user-editable, and are not unique.
Entries are validated at load, so a typo or nonexistent fusion fails loudly instead of
GRANULARITY is per-fusion, not per-build: banning MAROWAK/REGIGIGAS bans every build of
it (both Gaiatitan and Marogigas). That matches real tiering - you ban the Pokemon.
Tiers inherit: uu inherits ou, ou inherits ubers. Legendary fusions are excluded from
ou/uu automatically by the engine's OU tier filter, so they need no banlist entries.
Standard clauses (Spore, Moody, Shadow Tag, Arena Trap, Baton Pass, Swagger, OHKO moves)
apply to EVERY tier and are handled separately in nladder.rb.

ubers.desc: Anything goes. Multipliers, free-turn abilities, and legendary fusions all legal.

ou.desc: Ubers minus the broken mechanics: Huge Power, Thick Club, Light Ball (attack multipliers) and Disguise / Multiscale (free setup turn). Legendary fusions excluded by the tier filter.

uu.desc: OU minus OU's own top performers: every fusion used on >=15% of teams in the ladder_tou OU benchmark (100 teams, 20 batches). Note the ladder's usage cap is 30%, so the top entry is saturated and would rank higher uncapped.
